projects.name: , scope, timelines, deliverables, quality, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder
details: satisfaction.
• Managed end-to-end regional migration activities for banking/card operations, coordinating
transition from the source region to the target region across planning, dependencies, resource
readiness, testing, cutover and BAU transition. Drove process standardisation across regional
teams by reviewing variations in existing workflows and aligning procedures, controls and
delivery practices to support consistent operations during and after migration.
• Led project planning and execution across the complete delivery lifecycle, translating business
objectives into actionable project plans, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, and
release schedules. Monitored project progress, identified deviations, managed dependencies,
and implemented corrective actions to ensure on-time and within-scope delivery.
• Maintained project plans, milestones, dependencies, forecasts and delivery status in Clarity,
ensuring accurate tracking and governance throughout the project lifecycle. Identified and
tracked non-standard scenarios and operational exceptions during migration, assessing
impacts, coordinating resolution with business and technology stakeholders, and driving
closure before go-live. Documented current-state and target-state processes and developed
detailed SOPs/process documentation to support operational transition, standardisation,
knowledge transfer and BAU readiness.
• Managed and mentored cross-functional teams comprising Business Analysts, Java
Developers, QA Engineers, UI/UX Designers, DevOps Engineers, Architects, and third-party
vendors. Applied Agile and Waterfall methodologies based on project requirements and
facilitated sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives,
release planning, and delivery governance.
• Served as the primary interface between clients, business stakeholders, product owners, and
technical teams, driving requirement workshops, solution discussions, project status reviews,
stakeholder communications, executive updates, and decision-making. Built strong client
relationships and ensured alignment on scope, priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes.
• Coordinated SIT, UAT, production deployments, and post-production support in collaboration
with QA, infrastructure, DevOps, application, and business teams. Managed defect triage,
release readiness, deployment dependencies, user acceptance, production stabilization, and
transition to business-as-usual operations.
• Drove process standardisation across regional teams by reviewing variations in existing
workflows and aligning procedures, controls and delivery practices to support consistent
operations during and after migration. Managed third-party vendors and delivery
dependencies, coordinating activities, tracking commitments, monitoring deliverables, and
ensuring adherence to agreed timelines, quality standards, and project objectives.
• Established effective project communication and governance mechanisms, including status
reporting, milestone tracking, action and decision logs, risk/issue tracking, stakeholder
updates, and delivery reviews, providing management with clear visibility into project health
and progress.
